Infested Plants#003.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#004.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#006.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!

Infested Plants#007.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#009.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#012.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#014.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#014.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#015.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#015.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#017.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#018.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.

Infested Plants#019.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#019.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#020.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#020.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#021.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#023.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- I can, uh, offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time.
Infested Plants#023.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#025.src: It has been a time, soldiers, but I truly must be going! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road! Go and speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#028.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#028.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#029.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#030.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#030.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#031.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#031.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#032.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with.
Infested Plants#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#033.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#033.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#034.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#034.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#035.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay is.
Infested Plants#035.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#036.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...

Infested Plants#037.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-

Infested Plants#038.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?

Infested Plants#040.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!

Infested Plants#041.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...

Infested Plants#042.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.

Infested Plants#043.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?

Infested Plants#044.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.

Infested Plants#045.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.

Infested Plants#046.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!

Infested Plants#047.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!

Infested Plants#048.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.

Infested Plants#049.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?

Infested Plants#050.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.

Infested Plants#051.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!

Infested Plants#052.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!

Infested Plants#053.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.

Infested Plants#054.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.

Infested Plants#055.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.

Infested Plants#056.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...

Infested Plants#057.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!

Infested Plants#058.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-

Infested Plants#059.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!

Infested Plants#060.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!

Infested Plants#062.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.

Infested Plants#063.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.

Infested Plants#064.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?

Infested Plants#065.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.

Infested Plants#066.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.

Infested Plants#067.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.

Infested Plants#068.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
